# Security policy — nexus-ways.com and Nexus Desk

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately to **desk@nexus-ways.com** with "Security" in the subject line. Do not open
a public issue. Include the affected URL, the steps to reproduce the issue and its impact. We acknowledge reports
within five working days.

## Scope

- The static website at https://nexus-ways.com, including Nexus Desk at /desk/.
- The consultation and contact forms, which are delivered through Web3Forms.
- This repository's build, validation and deployment workflows.

Out of scope: denial-of-service testing, social engineering, and automated scanning that generates load against the
production site.

## What this site does not hold

The site has no user accounts, no payments and no database. Prices, financial analyses, investor details and project
documents are never stored in this repository or on the website. The internal operating procedures, including
incident response, are in `desk/_tools/OPERATIONS.md`.
